Who we are

At Intact Insurance Specialty Solutions, we are experts at what we do in protecting what makes businesses unique. Our deep understanding of the specialty insurance market is the foundation for our customized solutions, backed by targeted risk control and claims services. Our employees are passionate about providing insurance coverage that’s aligned to our targeted customer groups.

Intact’s Global Specialty Lines business spans across more than 20 verticals in four distinct markets: U.S., Canada, UK and Europe. The following opportunity is for our U.S. team.

The opportunity

We currently have an opportunity for a Senior Underwriter to join our Crime & Fidelity team located remotely nationwide. Under technical direction and within underwriting authority reviews complex risks to determine acceptance of an application. Determines selection or rejection of new and/or renewal business using underwriting rules and guidelines, manual rating rules and insurance laws and regulations. Analyzes quality and quantity of risks written and prepares reports accordingly. Monitors and evaluates results of assigned producers and assigned territory. Recommends and implements action plans for improvement of underwriting results for assigned producers and assigned territory. May act as a coach/mentor to newer or less-experienced underwriters and assistants. Some of the Senior Underwriter responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Manages a profitable book of business by evaluating results and conducting portfolio reviews for assigned territory and individual producers. Develops integrated pictures of factors that affect profitability, growth, retention and recommends, implements, and monitors necessary action plans.
  • Has underwriting responsibility for a book of new and renewal business. Examines, identifies, and evaluates exposures by analyzing documentation from various sources, such as the insurance application, internet searches, inspection reports, credit reports, etc. Makes underwriting decisions to accept, decline, or modify risks within assigned underwriting authority level in partnership with underwriting team. Executes underwriting strategy as determined by management, including portfolio management and self-audits. Implements underwriting decisions in compliance with state laws and company guidelines.
  • Develops superior working relationships with producers to successfully promote achievement of mutual operating goals (growth, retention, and profitability) and to supply the appropriate products and services. Determines and executes strategy for account management and agency planning. Works closely with other departments, including claims, actuary and risk control staff in an effort to better service producers and accounts.
  • Gathers and analyzes competitor and producer information including producers’ retention, profitability and potential, in support of pricing and appetite. Works with other underwriting staff to determine and make recommendations for marketing, pricing, products and systems.
  • Collaborates with team members to manage work inventories and all production activities to provide accurate and timely service in accordance with business unit standards. Processes underwriting decisions. Documents files and reports via automated desktop systems and tools.
  • Regularly travels to key producers/accounts and remains a visible presence in the marketplace. Monitors agency action plans and participates in account management, agency planning and marketing meetings to best position the business for the future. May participate in industry events and/or committees.
  • Provides training and mentoring to less experienced underwriters and/or underwriting assistants.
  • Stays abreast of industry, territory and insurance trends.

The expertise you bring

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 3-5 years progressively complex specialty underwriting experience
  • Professional insurance designation is preferred (AICPCU, RPLU)

We live our Values: We are committed to acting with the highest of ethical standards through our five core values: integrity, respect, customer driven, excellence and social responsibility.

Our commitment to Diversity: Founded in our values, we see diversity as a strength and aspire to create an environment where everyone can be themselves, grow and succeed. Together, we will stand up for what’s right to build an inclusive society.

Manage your Time: What you accomplish matters more than hours in the office. We are committed to creating a positive and supportive environment in which you perform your best. Our Time-Off and Flexible Work Arrangement options help foster a healthy work-life balance.

Check out our Glassdoor reviews to see why people love working for Intact!

Our promise to you

Our Values are foundational to our success at Intact. You’ll make a difference every day when you live our Values, do your best work, are open to change, and invest in yourself.

In return, we promise you support, opportunities, and performance-led financial rewards in a flexible work environment where you can:

  • Shape the future: Help us lead an insurance transformation to better protect people, businesses and society.
  • Win as a team: Collaborate with inspiring people to do your best work every day and together, stand up for what is right.
  • Grow with us: Refresh and reinvent your skills, learn from our diverse teams, lift others up, and grow.

At Intact Insurance Specialty Solutions we are experts at what we do. Our deep understanding of the specialty insurance market is the foundation for our customized solutions, backed by targeted risk control and claims services. Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

The Team Manager will lead a team of Site Reliability Engineers, promoting the development and execution of quality services and continuous improvements in support of the company’s goal of providing superior client experience, promoting a culture of high performance and continuous learning and development.

The Team Manager will be responsible for the delivery of high-quality technical services and adherence to Pythian and client processes; lead their team through the implementation of customized client services; be an influential leader with talent in people management; Champion a culture of continuous improvement and development of team members.

As a first step in the application, you will be required to complete an online technical assessment so that we better understand your SRE technical skills.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead and mentor a team of SRE to ensure technical excellence, timely resolution of incidents, and professional growth of team members.
  • Drive strategic service delivery and operational excellence by optimizing workload distribution, automating toil, and ensuring the team exceeds strict SLA targets for high-profile enterprise clients.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for critical escalations and severity-1 incidents, providing guidance and technical direction.
  • Provide 24/7 management on-call support for the team.
  • Conduct performance reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions to strengthen the team’s capabilities.
  • Collaborate with management on performance metrics, process adherence, and resource planning.
  • Sets specific goals and objectives for team members as part of Pythian’s goal planning program.
  • Provides guidance to team members regarding training opportunities as part of Pythian’s self-directed training program.
  • Meets regularly with team members for one-on-one sessions to disseminate information and gain feedback on opportunities for improvement.
  • Reviews and reports on technical work completed by team members.
  • Ensures team members’ adherence to Pythian and client processes.
  • Works with the Director to complete resource planning to enable sustainable growth.
  • Act as a strategic technical advisor to key enterprise clients, deeply understanding their business goals and tailoring Pythian’s SRE/DevOps services to drive their long-term infrastructure reliability and scalability.
  • Works with the Director to disseminate information and direction from Pythian’s leadership teams.
  • Foster a culture of psychological safety, encouraging proactive problem-solving, blameless post-mortems, and continuous innovation among senior technical staff.

What we need from you:

  • A minimum of 3 years of previous experience leading and managing technical teams, specifically with a track record of guiding senior-level SRE and DevOps engineers.
  • Proven experience managing complex, high-stakes enterprise client relationships. Ability to confidently interface with high-level client stakeholders and act as a trusted advisor.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Must be able to seamlessly translate complex technical challenges and strategic goals between C-level executives and highly technical engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated resilience and composure under pressure. Strong crisis management and escalation handling skills, with a proven ability to steer teams through significant technical, operational, and client-facing challenges.
  • Proven experience in SRE and/or DevOps with a strong SRE and DevOps mindset and a relentless focus on CI/CD orchestration, release management, deployment automation, scalability, toil reduction, and system reliability.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, particularly Terraform.
  • Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), advanced networking concepts, and CI/CD pipeline tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Hands-on experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), service mesh technologies, and Linux systems administration.

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favourite charity.

  • Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process.

AI Disclaimer

While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. By applying for this position, you consent to Pythian’s use of these AI tools in the evaluation of your application. jobs.excerpt: ABOUT PERLE Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Mesopotamian Arabic (Iraqi) transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Iraqi Arabic in both Gilit (central and southern Iraq) and Qeltu (northern Iraq) varieties, with substantial Persian, Turkish, and Aramaic lexical influence. Project audio reflects everyday Iraqi speech, with Baghdad standard as a common reference point.

Primary speaker regions: Baghdad, Basra, Mosul, Najaf, Karbala, Erbil.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Iraqi Arabic with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Iraq
  • Strong command of Modern Standard Arabic for orthographic decisions on dialectal speech
  • Ability to distinguish Gilit and Qeltu varieties and major regional accents
  • Familiarity with Persian, Turkish, and Aramaic loanwords as they appear in speech
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Iraqi or Mesopotamian Arabic linguistics, translation, or journalism
  • Prior experience annotating Iraqi or Gulf Arabic speech data
  • Working knowledge of Kurdish or Persian for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT PERLE Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Icelandic transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Icelandic (islenska), a conservative North Germanic language with limited regional dialectal variation. Project audio reflects everyday Icelandic speech across formal and conversational registers.

Primary speaker regions: Reykjavik, Akureyri, Hafnarfjordur, Kopavogur, Selfoss, Akranes.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Icelandic with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Iceland
  • Mastery of current Icelandic orthography including diacritics and special characters
  • Strong handling of Icelandic inflectional morphology in transcription
  • Comfort transcribing both formal and colloquial Icelandic registers
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Scandinavian or Germanic linguistics, translation, journalism, or media
  • Prior experience annotating Icelandic speech data
  • Working knowledge of Faroese, Old Norse, or other Scandinavian languages
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT PERLE Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Portuguese (European) transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Portuguese in either its European or Brazilian standard, depending on the project. The two varieties differ significantly in phonology, vocabulary, and certain grammatical features. The project lead will specify the target variety and regional focus before onboarding.

Primary speaker regions: Variety set per project (European or Brazilian).

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Portuguese with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Portugal or Brazil
  • Mastery of Portuguese orthography per the current Acordo Ortografico
  • Ability to distinguish European and Brazilian Portuguese in transcription decisions
  • Strong ear for regional accents within your declared variety
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Portuguese linguistics, translation, journalism, or media
  • Prior experience annotating Portuguese-language speech data
  • Working knowledge of PALOP varieties (Angolan, Mozambican, Cape Verdean) or Galician for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Risk & Response
jobs.excerpt: About usCoalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes.
jobs.description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

This is a new role leading a new grouping of three areas that together form Coalition's risk lifecycle: Underwriting (how we select and price risk), Claims (how we close the loop and mitigate losses when something goes wrong), and Security (the Control and Wirespeed products that help policyholders reduce risk in the first place). Each of these has historically been run as its own domain. Your job is to be strategic about how these areas come closer together, recognizing that risk selection, loss mitigation, security telemetry, and claims outcomes are not separate problems but one continuous feedback loop.

This is a people-leadership role. You will manage a team of product managers across all three areas, help to steer the strategy that connects them, and be accountable for how the combined areas perform. You'll report into product leadership and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, Finance, Operations, and more.

Most of the value in Active Insurance comes from the connections between these functions, not the functions themselves. Security signals from Control and Wirespeed should sharpen how we underwrite. How a claim develops should feed back into how we price risk. The quality of underwriting should shape our loss exposure and therefore our claims load. Today these loops exist, but they aren't owned by anyone as a whole.

This role is deliberately the one seat that spans them. It is not a preview of how the rest of the company is organized, and we want to be explicit about that. Engineering leadership for each of these areas reports through the CTO in separate lines. Underwriting, Claims, and Security operate as genuinely different businesses with different economics, different stakeholders, and different rhythms, and we are not trying to merge them. What we are doing is deliberately creating a single product seat that sits across all three, because the connective work is real and currently unowned, and because product is the function best positioned to do it. That means the primary instrument of this role is influence, clarity, and a credible point of view rather than formal authority over the full stack. If that sounds like the interesting part of the job rather than the frustrating part, we should talk.

Why Security sits in a risk group. Control is our attack surface monitoring and login security product: we continuously monitor policyholders' external attack surface, watch their Google and Microsoft environments, and lock down accounts that look compromised. It's provided free to all 100,000+ policyholders, and it exists because reducing their exposure directly reduces our loss ratio. That makes it a risk lifecycle product, not a side business, and it is why it belongs alongside underwriting and claims. Wirespeed MDR is a different motion: a paid, growing revenue line sold both into our policyholder base and to companies who don't buy insurance from us at all. Both matter, and part of the judgment this role requires is holding those two very different mandates at the same time without letting either starve the other.

What You'll Own

  • Underwriting. The internal risk decisioning stack: underwriting models and the real-time systems that execute them, the underwriter workbench and tooling, automation and risk selection, scanning and data collection, and insurance product development. Actuarial builds the pricing models; this organization is accountable for the systems that put them into production correctly, ensuring the right customer data reaches the right model at the right moment, that changes are testable and auditable, and that pricing behaves in production the way it was designed to. This portfolio is about the quality, consistency, speed, and auditability of underwriting decisions through better software and model-driven workflows.
  • Claims. The claims operations engine: intake, adjudication, and enablement systems, workflow tools, automation, platform migrations, and ML-assisted insights. The center of gravity is operational excellence and reducing manual overhead so claims professionals can focus on judgment, empathy, and resolution strategy, while claims data feeds back into how we understand risk.
  • Security (Control & Wirespeed). Control as the connective layer between security telemetry, the policyholder experience, and underwriting workflows, including its growing role as an underwriting-facing platform (underwriting integrations, outbound ticketing, large-market and multi-tenant support). And Wirespeed's MDR/ADR capabilities, integrations, reporting, and competitiveness in a crowded market. The two remain distinct products with distinct goals: Control's job is adoption and measurable risk reduction across the insured base; Wirespeed's job is to win on product merit against dedicated MDR competitors.

What You'll Do

  • Ensure that our product strategy across underwriting, claims, and security is consistent and treats them as one risk lifecycle, and make the deliberate trade-offs about where to invest across the three.
  • Build and develop the product team beneath you, including hiring, coaching, and holding a group of PMs to a high standard across three distinct domains, each with its own stakeholders and technical depth.
  • Own the feedback loops between areas: ensure security telemetry informs underwriting, claims development informs pricing, and underwriting quality is measured against realized loss outcomes.
  • Own the product surface that makes security adoption possible and scalable: the in-product activation, onboarding, and value-demonstration motions that drive policyholders into Control, and the product-led growth capabilities that convert engaged Control users into paid Wirespeed customers. The commercial motion spans GTM and the broker channel, and you'll partner closely with both, but the product mechanics that make the funnel work are in your domain.
  • Partner with Data and Engineering to advance model-driven workflows, automated decisioning, and ML-assisted tooling responsibly while managing the operational and regulatory considerations that come with automated decisions in a regulated product.
  • Drive major platform evolution and systems migrations across the portfolio, in close partnership with your engineering counterparts.
  • Define success metrics that span the portfolio, not just each area in isolation, and use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and make trade-offs.
  • Represent these areas to executive leadership, brokers, and cross-functional partners, translating between deep technical work and business outcomes.
  • Use AI consistently in how you and your team work, and champion an AI-enabled approach to underwriting, claims, and security products.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with several years leading and developing product managers
  • A track record of owning a multi-domain or platform portfolio and setting strategy across areas that can have competing priorities, finding the connective tissue and making trade-offs across it.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead in technically deep, model-driven, or data-heavy product areas, and to partner effectively with Data and Engineering on automation and decisioning.
  • Strong people leadership: you hire well, coach deliberately, set clear expectations, and make hard calls on performance without delay.
  • Proven experience with major platform migrations or systems transformations of critical internal or enterprise systems.
  • Exceptional communication and influence skills, with a track record of driving alignment across diverse senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a build mindset. This is a role for someone who wants to define how these areas operate together, not maintain a settled structure.
  • Daily fluency with AI tools as part of product work, and a point of view on how AI reshapes underwriting, claims, and security over time.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with the business of insurance or other regulated financial products due to the underwriting, pricing, claims, policy administration, and compliance-heavy workflows.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity products, MDR/EDR, security operations, or incident response.
  • Prior work shipping products built on predictive models, risk scores, or automated decisioning while managing operational and regulatory constraints.

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $200,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $260,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Perks

  • 100% medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
  • Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >

Privacy Notice

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

Our Privacy Policy >

Safe Hiring Notice

All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you’ve been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC).

Anti-Discrimination Notice

Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace.

Accommodations

Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at . We also consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws and regulations in each jurisdiction.

To all recruitment agencies: Coalition does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our email alias, employees, or other physical or virtual organization locations. Coalition is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
Our mission at Greenhouse is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive product input and go-to-market strategy for our core platform.

This role will deeply understand the voice of the customer and increase customer lifetime value. You’ll ensure we have crisp narratives, compelling offers, and repeatable motions that help customers understand the value of our newest solutions and “better together” partner stories.

You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and channel/partner teams to shape new offerings, define how they show up in the market, and build the GTM muscle that turns early traction into scalable growth. This is a strategic and hands-on role, with a mix of upstream product work, launch execution, and ongoing iteration to support GTM campaigns.

Who will love this job

  • A full stack PMM – You love evolving existing and developing new products from idea to market, creating a compelling story, packaging, and driving the GTM from start to finish.
  • A strong and independent executor - You thrive on owning all aspects of GTM success for your product domain, owning and driving, and working closely with Product to develop out ideas.
  • A cross-functional connector & influencer – You thrive on partnering with Product, Sales, and Marketing, and can rally diverse stakeholders around clear narratives and plans.
  • A sharp storyteller – You’re excellent at turning complex concepts (integrations, AI workflows, multi-party solutions) into simple, concrete stories that resonate with customers, the field, and partners.
  • An AI adopter and advocate – You’re using the latest technologies to automate workflows, save time, and spend the creative human needed energy where it matters most.

What you’ll do

  • Flexible, follow the opportunity attitude towards juggling priorities

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and organizational skills, with the ability to act as the GTM “driver” for launches—managing multiple initiatives, aligning stakeholders, and bringing structure to complex efforts.

Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Only LATAM-based candidates (bilingual in Spanish and English)
​
The Floating Medical Office Customer Serviceposition provides temporary administrative coverage to different medical practices when staffing gaps occur due to vacations, sick leave, resignations, increased workload, or other unexpected absences.
Unlike an assistant dedicated to a single client, the floating assistant must be able to quickly adapt to different providers, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols while maintaining service quality and minimizing disruption to the client.
The position follows a rapid deployment model, meaning the floating assistant is not permanently assigned to a fixed group of clients. Instead, onboarding is provided when coverage is required for a specific medical practice.
Responsibilities
Responsibilities will depend on the workflows and operational requirements of each assigned medical practice and may include:
  • Following appointment scheduling rules and provider preferences.
  • Supporting insurance workflows.
  • Assisting with referral processes.
  • Supporting prior authorization procedures.
  • Following patient communication protocols and telephone scripts.
  • Following established escalation procedures.
  • Maintaining internal documentation standards.
  • Navigating Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.
  • Reviewing and following client-specific documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Following daily operational processes and checklists.
  • Adapting to different medical practices, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols.

Requirements

  • Must have your own device and headset
  • High-speed internet connection of at least 100 MB.
  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based medical offices and knowledge of HIPAA regulations.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different medical practices, providers, workflows, and operational protocols.
  • Ability to continuously learn and transition between different client environments.
  • Ability to learn and navigate different Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems and software platforms.
  • Ability to understand and follow practice-specific scheduling rules, insurance workflows, referral processes, prior authorization procedures, and patient communication protocols.
  • Ability to follow telephone scripts, escalation procedures, and internal documentation standards.
  • Ability to review and follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational guides, and daily checklists.
  • Ability to work effectively following an accelerated onboarding process for each new assignment.
  • Previous experience with medical offices is preferred.
Systems
Medical practices may use different software platforms, including:
  • Athenahealth
  • eClinicalWorks
  • Nextech
  • HealthArc
  • EMA
  • Other proprietary systems
The position requires the ability to understand not only the software used by each practice, but also the operational processes and procedures established by that particular medical office.
Assignment and Onboarding Model
When coverage is required:
  • A client reports an upcoming absence or unexpected staffing need.
  • A floating assistant is assigned.
  • The assistant receives an accelerated onboarding.
  • The assistant reviews the client's documentation.
  • The assistant begins providing temporary coverage until the assigned employee returns.
Because medical offices may operate differently, each assignment may require adaptation to new workflows, provider preferences, software systems, and operational procedures.
Comprehensive client documentation, structured onboarding, and ongoing support during the initial stages of each assignment are key components of the floating coverage model.

Серед них: маркетинг, продажі, управління командами майстрів, контроль якості, збір відгуків, навчання технічного персоналу тощо. Працюємо у 30+ найбільших містах США та вже успішно реалізували понад 30 000 ремонтних проєктів.

Детальніше про компанію ти можеш дізнатися за посиланням . Ти ознайомишся з нашою метою, критеріями, перевагами, а також відеовідгуками про роботу в Supplax від наших співробітників.

Наша компанія стрімко вдосконалюється та зростає, тож зараз ми у пошуку активного Sales Manager у відділ B2B. Ти відповідатимеш за роботу з холодною базою контактів: встановлення першого контакту з потенційними B2B-клієнтами, виявлення їхніх потреб та формування зацікавленості для подальшої взаємодії.

Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:
  • Повну зайнятість та п’ятиденний робочий тиждень.
  • Віддалений формат роботи.
  • Графік роботи: 16:00 — 01:00 за Києвом.
  • Повноцінне навчання та занурення у специфіку роботи.
  • Заробітну плату $800-$1000, складається зі ставки і бонусів, виплата в $.
  • Системну роботу з B2B клієнтами, а саме дизайнерами та контракторами.
  • Регулярну практику англійської мови з викладачем
  • Можливість швидко прокачати навички холодних дзвінків .
  • Кар'єрний ріст завдяки високим результатам роботи.
Твоя роль включає:
  • Активну роботу з холодними дзвінками (150+ дзвінків на день).
  • Ініціювання першого контакту з потенційними клієнтами та виявлення їхніх зацікавленості в співпраці.
  • Передача зацікавлених лідів на акаунт-менеджера.
Ти точно наш, якщо…
  • Маєш високий рівень розмовної англійської — не нижче C1 (або впевнений B2+ з регулярною практикою): позиція передбачає постійне спілкування з носіями мови.
  • Комфортно почуваєшся у холодних дзвінках та не боїшся активної комунікації.
  • Твоя зона комфорту — це багато розмов, ініціативність та робота на результат.
  • Умієш працювати у високому темпі.
  • Швидко навчаєшся та готовий постійно вдосконалювати свої навички холодних дзвінків.
Зацікавило? Відгукуйся та до зустрічі на співбесіді!

jobs.title: Director of Operations Technology & Automation
jobs.excerpt: About Homeaglow Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes.
jobs.description:
About Homeaglow

Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes. We delight customers and empower cleaning professionals by building the leading platform for home services. Today, we are the world’s largest marketplace for home cleanings. Tomorrow, we’ll be the world’s leading platform for all home services.

We are transforming the home services industry by making high-quality home cleanings more accessible, affordable, and transparent for everyone. We connect customers with independent, background-checked cleaning professionals through a modern technology platform that simplifies booking, pricing, and communication.

Why Join Homeaglow?

A True Startup Environment

Join a high-growth, entrepreneurial company where speed, ownership, and impact define the culture.

Sustained, Profitable Growth

Double-digit year-over-year growth at a nine-figure revenue scale, while serving less than 0.5% of U.S. households — with significant runway ahead.

Strong Unit Economics

Disciplined focus on LTV/CAC and long-term value creation drives sustainable expansion.

Bootstrapped & Focused

No liquidation preferences. No distracting investor pressure. Just stable priorities and long-term thinking.

Real Economic Impact

Over 100,000 cleaning professionals have earned $250M+ through our platform. Average earnings are ~50% higher than traditional hotel housekeeping roles.

Vertical Expansion Strategy

Significant opportunity to expand into adjacent services and deepen customer relationships.

Building a World-Class Team

Be part of a professional, high-caliber team scaling a category-defining platform.

About the Role

We are hiring a Director of Operations Technology & Automation, reporting directly to our Chief Operating Officer, to own the automation, technology, and AI integration into our customer facing teams. This is a pivotal role to chart the automation and AI integration course of a rapidly scaling $100 million+ marketplace, focused on improving quality of our customer experience, while directly driving revenue and increasing efficiency within our 1,000+ customer-facing agent population.

This role will own the roadmap on which automation and AI integration to prioritize, having autonomy to choose third parties, prioritize experiments, and leveraging our dedicated Operations engineers. Success is measured in incremental revenue, cost-to-serve, improved customer experience, and faster response and handle times — not in features shipped.

What You’ll Own

Roadmap & Prioritization

  • Build and maintain a rolling 12-month roadmap for Operations tooling, automation, and AI features, prioritized by risk-adjusted ROI - working closely with our fast-paced engineering team (including dedicated Ops engineers), as well as the broader Operations Org, and Strategy team.

Specs & Delivery

  • Write the product specs: problem statement, current state, target state, user flows, requirements, edge cases, success metrics, and rollout plan.
  • Act as the owner for each initiative end-to-end — from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurement - within a rigorous fast-paced AB testing environment.

AI Integration and Tooling

  • Be the leader integrating AI into the company, including making the buy vs. build decisions, and managing relationships and pilots with key vendors.
  • Leverage the relationships with Hubspot, Aircall, and smaller third parties to evaluate and integrate AI solutions - or decide to build in-house with our engineering team.
  • Translate operational pain points and revenue opportunities into a prioritized backlog for tooling improvements with clear hypotheses and success metrics.

Measurement & Operating Rhythm

  • Weekly reporting on KPIs - which you will define based on specific project focus areas, e.g., sales automation might prioritize conversion rate on leads or touch to connect ratio, care AI integration would show costs saved / improved handling time / increased customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain a tight feedback loop with frontline reps and managers — shadow shifts, sit in on calls, ship, iterate.
  • Roadmap review every six months (frequent enough to adjust course, not so frequent that all we’re doing is roadmapping - we’re a growth phase company, nobody cares about slides).

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years in product management, operations strategy, business systems, or RevOps roles, with at least 3 years owning a roadmap end-to-end.
  • Track record of shipping automation and AI/ML features that produced measurable productivity, conversion, or customer satisfaction gains. Be ready to talk numbers.
  • Direct experience building or owning internal tools for customer care, support, or sales — not just consuming them.
  • Strong product craft: you can write a crisp PRD, run a discovery interview, prioritize ruthlessly, and partner well with engineers.
  • Fluency with the modern stack: CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, or equivalent), helpdesk (Zendesk, Intercom, Kustomer, or equivalent), telephony, conversation intelligence, and LLM-powered assist tools.
  • Data literacy: comfortable defining metrics, reading dashboards, and using SQL or a BI tool to validate hypotheses on your own.

Travel Requirements

  • 4 - 6 weeks travel per year, including:
    • 1-2 trips to Manila (Philippines) for the Operations Offsite and Kick-off Party
    • 2 company / team offsites

Perks and Benefits

  • Health insurance fully covered by the company.
  • Parental leave.
  • Flexible / unlimited PTO policy.
  • Cleaning membership perk – Free Homeaglow membership with complimentary cleanings. Enjoy up to 2x cleanings a month, capped at $200 USD per cleaning.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Homeaglow is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Accommodations

We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our hiring process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.

Pay Transparency

Compensation ranges are available upon request. Final offers are based on experience, skills, and location in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws.

Tasks

Your responsibilities include:

  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of potential fundraising mandates

  • Activate and expand your existing investor network across venture capital funds, family offices, business angels, high-net-worth individuals, corporate venture arms, and strategic investors
  • Match selected companies with the right investor profiles and coordinate targeted investor introductions
  • Support the full fundraising process, including investor outreach, preparation of investor materials, due diligence coordination, term sheet discussions, and closing support
  • Build long-term relationships with founders, investors, family offices, and strategic partners
  • Introduce qualified investors, HNWIs and family offices

PROFILE:

You ideally have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Fundraising / Capital RaisingInvestor Relations
  • Private Banking / Wealth Management
  • Family Offices
  • Venture Capital / Private Equity
  • Corporate Finance / M&A FinTech / Financial Services
  • Business Development

Requirements

We are looking for a highly entrepreneurial and well-connected professional with a strong background in fundraising, venture capital, corporate finance, investment banking, or private markets.

Your profile:

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in venture capital, investment banking, corporate finance, fundraising advisory, M&A, private markets, or a comparable field
  • Proven track record in supporting, advising or executing Seed and Series A financing rounds
  • Existing and active investor network across the DACH region, especially with venture capital funds, family offices, business angels, high-net-worth individuals, or strategic investors

Important: Applications without verifiable experience in venture capital, fundraising, corporate finance, investment banking, or startup financing cannot be considered. An existing investor network is a central requirement for this role.

  • Attractive compensation structure with fixed and performance-based components
  • Strong upside potential through success-based fees on successfully closed transactions
  • Flexible working model across the DACH region, remote or hybrid
  • Opportunity to build and shape a high-quality network of startups, investors, family offices and strategic partners

If you have the network to open doors and the track record to support successful financing rounds, we would be pleased to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Conveyor 👋 creators of the first AI-Native Customer Trust Platform.

We solve a problem that our customers “hate with the fury of 1000 suns” (actual quote!) - the dreaded customer security review. It’s a key part of the B2B sales cycle, but one that still involves too much time, effort, and mental anguish from those involved.

Enter Conveyor, where our vision is instant, perfect security reviews for everyone. We’ve made a lot of progress – we have an awesome customer list whose lives we’vesignificantly impacted through product, we launched the first AI agents for security reviews and RFPs, and we raised a $20M Series B from SignalFire and OVF! (TechCrunch) But we have ambitious goals and we’re looking for our next Senior Software Engineer to help make them a reality!

The top 3 1/2 reasons you should be interested in working at Conveyor:

  1. You’ll be building a great product with a slam dunk AI use case, and as part of a small team, be involved in the entire lifecycle of development (design, frontend, backend, AI).

  2. Everyone on the team is amazing at their jobs. We care deeply about psychological safety, and believe that the ability to take risks and exist in the learning zone is critical to our success. This also comes with high accountability, which isn’t for everyone. But, you have the potential to have an outsize impact on the direction and success of the company.

  3. We’re highly transparent and collaborative. Giving constructive, thoughtful feedback and asking hard questions are highly encouraged! We come together to figure it out when times are hard, and in celebration when we get our wins.

    ½ Plus we’ll even teach you how to saber a bottle of champagne.

About the Role

This role is to join our new initiatives team, as one of the first engineers on the team. This is a unique opportunity to shape Conveyor’s future offerings and strategy, and have a huge impact on our success. Designing and building innovative new AI-powered products and capabilities, you will have the opportunity to collaborate closely with a great team, as well tackle challenging engineering problems on your own.

What you’ll do:

  • You will design, implement and maintain new products and capabilities, taking full ownership across the stack (backend, frontend and AI).

  • You'll autonomously manage and own individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

  • You’ll collaborate and pair frequently with teammates and peers.

  • You'll inform the product roadmap and implementation decisions based on feasibility.

  • You'll ensure that our product is maintainable, meaning that other engineers are able to contribute new functionality easily, and without frequent technical debt.

  • You'll partner with Product and Design to effectively plan new features, avoiding bottlenecks and maximizing velocity when it comes time to implement.

  • Provide constructive feedback through design and code reviews, and mentor to new or junior team members

What we’re looking for:

We are looking for candidates with 5-8 years of experience as a Fullstack Software Engineer, with a focus on B2B SaaS solutions, and experience in startup environments.

  • 5-8 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with strong foundations on building and shipping products. Your designs should be performant, maintainable (for years, not months), and evolvable.

  • Experience building and scaling web applications with real users, familiarity with SaaS architecture concepts, Cloud infrastructure and services (AWS preferred), popular databases, authentication services, etc.

  • Specifically, rich experience working across the stack: Python, React, RESTful APIs, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, AWS, use of LLMs and AI coding tools

  • Bias for action: Startup mentality, get things done, fast iterations, scope and implement project-level solutions with minimal guidance, strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Previous experience in a small startup (or as a founder) is highly preferred.

  • Curiosity and Continuous Learning: You are up to speed on developments in fullstack technologies and patterns, and constantly thinking about how to apply new technologies and offerings to our platform.

  • Desire to Improve: You seek to understand why things are the way they are, and think about ways to make them better.

  • Product Sense: You seek to understand the features you're working on, and actively propose positive changes. Collaborate with product and design to inform roadmap decisions.

  • Team Player: You have excellent communication skills (verbal and written), enjoy collaborating with others and mentoring team members.

  • Deliver Legendary Customer Experience: You have experience building and scaling products that delight real users.

  • Ownership: Strong sense of ownership and accountability, honor commitments and be transparent about challenges.


Job Location

This position is available in the United States and Canada.
We are a remote-first company so you’ll be working from home most of the time, traveling for in person sessions a few times a year.

The estimated total compensation for this role is $190,000 - $220,000 per year.

Ready to join our team and have a tremendous impact? We’d love to hear from you. Also, we know it’s tough, but please try to avoid the ​​confidence gap​.​​ You don’t have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Packaging Senior
jobs.excerpt: Ash Ind France SASÊtes-vous le type de personne qui réfléchit en permanence, esquisse des idées, cherche des solutions et ajuste constamment les choses ?
jobs.description:
Ash Ind France SAS

Êtes-vous le type de personne qui réfléchit en permanence, esquisse des idées, cherche des solutions et ajuste constamment les choses ? Qui a besoin de comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent avant de déterminer comment elles pourraient fonctionner encore mieux ? Êtes-vous une personne passionnée, persévérante, orientée résolution de problèmes, qui aime travailler avec d'autres personnes partageant la même motivation ? Êtes-vous positif(ve), constructif(ve) et ingénieux(se) ?

Êtes-vous toujours en train de résoudre des problèmes ?

Alors nous aimerions vous rencontrer, et nous parions que vous aimeriez également nous rencontrer.

Ashland offre une opportunité passionnante pour un(e) Ingénieur Packaging au sein du département Global Engineering d'Ashland. Il s'agit d'un poste très visible et stratégique au sein de l'entreprise, avec un rôle de leader technique mondial pour les équipements de conditionnement et les standards associés, couvrant les produits chimiques solides et liquides destinés à des marchés finaux réglementés. Ce poste est entièrement en télétravail et sera placé sous la responsabilité du Directeur de l'Ingénierie.

Les responsabilités incluent notamment :

  • Assurer la standardisation des formats d'emballage, des matériaux et des équipements à l'échelle mondiale tout en maintenant la conformité réglementaire ainsi que les exigences spécifiques des clients.
  • Développer des solutions d'emballage durables, fiables et économiquement performantes grâce à une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Achats, Opérations, Ingénierie, Affaires Réglementaires, Qualité et EHS (Environnement, Hygiène et Sécurité).
  • Piloter les initiatives liées au packaging et gérer la documentation conformément aux objectifs du règlement européen relatif aux emballages et aux déchets d'emballages (PPWR).
  • Diriger les programmes de conformité relatifs aux emballages et aux déchets d'emballages selon les exigences nationales relevant des réglementations de Responsabilité Élargie du Producteur (REP/EPR).
  • Participer de manière concrète à l'installation et à la modernisation (retrofit) des équipements de conditionnement.
  • Élaborer les spécifications techniques et standards globaux.
  • Travailler avec les Achats afin de permettre une mise en concurrence efficace des fournisseurs et garantir une qualité constante.
  • Travailler avec l'Ingénierie pour piloter les projets d'investissement liés au packaging, depuis la phase de conception jusqu'aux essais, à la mise en service et au démarrage des équipements.
  • Déplacements professionnels : vous aurez l'opportunité de voyager et de rencontrer vos collègues à travers le monde environ 30 % de votre temps.
  • Contribuer activement aux objectifs de l'organisation en faisant preuve d'initiative, en atteignant les objectifs fixés et en accordant une attention particulière à la performance et à la sécurité.
  • Renforcer les capacités et les compétences de l'organisation en développant des relations collaboratives, en valorisant la diversité des talents et en utilisant une communication positive ainsi qu'une influence constructive auprès des autres.

Ce que ce poste n'est pas :

  • Ce n'est pas un poste de management : bien que vous collaboriez avec différentes équipes et départements, il s'agit d'un rôle d'expert technique (Subject Matter Expert) sans responsabilité hiérarchique directe.
  • Ce n'est pas un poste de chef de projet : l'accent est mis sur les aspects techniques des projets d'investissement et sur la réussite technique et réglementaire de ces projets.
  • Ce n'est pas un poste débutant : nous recherchons une personne immédiatement opérationnelle, disposant d'une expérience solide et d'un parcours démontrant cette expertise. L'autonomie et l'esprit d'initiative sont essentiels

Qualifications requises :

  • Diplôme de niveau Bac+5 ou équivalent en ingénierie mécanique, industrielle ou du packaging.
  • 10 années d'expérience progressive dans le domaine du packaging industriel ou chimique.
  • Une expérience dans des environnements industriels soumis à des exigences réglementaires.
  • Une bonne connaissance des réglementations européennes relatives au packaging et au développement durable.
  • Une expérience dans le sourcing des matériaux d'emballage et la gestion des fournisseurs.
  • Une expérience des essais, de la validation et de la gestion des modifications liées au packaging.
  • Une expérience dans l'exécution de projets d'investissement (Capital Projects).
  • Une maîtrise d'Excel et de l'analyse de données.
  • D'excellentes compétences relationnelles et de communication.
  • Un comportement responsable et éthique en toutes circonstances.
  • La capacité à créer de la valeur pour l'entreprise en comprenant les enjeux business, en prenant des décisions complexes et en apportant des solutions nouvelles et différenciantes.
  • Une maîtrise courante de l'anglais.

In more than 100 countries, the people of Ashland LLC. (NYSE: ASH) provide the specialty chemicals, technologies and insights to help customers create new and improved products for today and sustainable solutions for tomorrow. Our chemistry is at work every day in a wide variety of markets and applications, including architectural coatings, automotive, construction, energy, personal care and pharmaceutical. Visit www.ashland.com to see the innovations we offer.

At Ashland our vision is to be a leading, global specialty chemicals company whose inspired and engaged employees add value to all we touch. In fact our people, employees, customers and vendors define who we are. They are the driving force behind everything we do.

Not only do we value our customers but we value our employees, and we work to offer them a dynamic and challenging environment. We hold ourselves to high standards at Ashland, and we value integrity and honesty.

Ashland has a history of attracting the best people and keeping them. The reasons are simple: industry competitive salary and benefits, pay-for-performance incentive plans and a diverse work environment where employees feel challenged and valued. Senior Product Designer

Design · Remote · Full-time

About Shortcut

Our mission is to ensure software development teams can do their best work. Shortcut is the project management platform that teams actually want to use: fast, intuitive, and lightweight enough to stay out of the way while keeping everything moving.

With Korey, our agentic AI layer, we're going further: automatically surfacing context, structuring work across tools, and keeping teams in the loop. We're building Shortcut and Korey around a simple belief: the future of software development is people and agents working side-by-side, on one platform.

We're a remote-first company with a lean, experienced team. We move fast, trust people to make good calls, and communicate openly. We care about the craft of what we build, and we think software that's genuinely enjoyable to use is worth the effort it takes to get there.

The Role

We're a product development team where everyone ships. You should be excited to work as someone who produces product experiences through design and shipping code. You’ll work closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams.

You should be a product designer who moves fluidly from developing features in Figma and Claude to implementing them in code, shortening the path from concept to production.

You thrive on moving from concept to implementation, iterating based on real user feedback, and refining experiences through hands-on experimentation. You sweat the details of interaction design, understand how modern AI products behave in practice, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers while contributing directly to the codebase. You're excited by designing repeatable patterns that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive, reliable, and enjoyable to use.

How We Work

We’re building the project management platform for software teams and their agents, and we work that way ourselves. Agentic tools are part of everyday life at Shortcut: we expect you to use them alongside your expertise and experience as a designer to ideate, prototype, and ship.

This part of our industry is evolving fast, and we support our team with dedicated funds and time to learn, experiment, and share best practices as a team. The craft here is moving up the stack: less time pushing pixels, and more time using your design judgment and strategy.

What You’ll Do

  • Contribute to product design across our products, from early concepts to shipped experiences
  • Prototype quickly, and take ideas from an idea to a working build
  • Use AI to sharpen the design process itself, not just to move faster
  • Distill feedback and complex problems into focused solutions
  • Partner closely with product and engineering on both strategy and day-to-day execution

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience designing web applications, with hands-on experience incorporating agents and LLMs into production over the last 2+ years
  • Comfortable shipping code as part of how you design, not just handing off specs
  • Experience prototyping with Figma, HTML, CSS, and coding agents
  • Strong storytelling and communication skills – you don't mind being a visible voice for your work
  • Open to feedback and quick to adapt and iterate toward the best solution

Benefits & Perks

Compensation

  • Equity, giving you real ownership in what we're building

Time Off

  • Flexible, open vacation policy
  • Company holidays, plus paid safe & sick days and volunteer PTO days
  • Generous parental leave

  • Annual learning stipend to spend on courses, books, or conferences

Remote & Equipment

  • Fully remote: we ship you the equipment you need to do your best work
  • Generous home-office stipend to set up a workspace that works for you

As a Life Underwriting Specialist, you'll analyze, select and classify applications for life insurance of a moderately complex nature according to established underwriting policies, practices and standards. You'll coordinate life insurance selection standards according to underwriting practices and procedures to achieve satisfactory mortality and morbidity experience and acceptable administrative results. We'll count on you to use independent judgment based on your underwriting authority and company underwriting standards.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Receives, evaluates and underwrites, on a medical or non-medical basis, mild to moderately complex applications for life insurance up to their maximum handling limit as approved by the Chief Underwriter. Protects the confidentiality of documentation and information acquired throughout the underwriting process. Operates with autonomy but still uses referral points – mentors, staff underwriters and medical staff – as needed.

  • Maintains in-depth knowledge of manuals, underwriting materials, rules, regulations, procedures medical factors and practices impacting mortality and morbidity underwriting. Determines the need for and authorizes the ordering of, underwriting requirements to include, but not limited to, medical examinations, blood profiles, home office specimens, attending physician reports, inspection reports, client direct interviews, and other essential information.

This may include but not limited to, making fluid-less underwriting decisions as well as the utilization of alternative sources of medical information while maintaining appropriate tolerance for accepting risk.

  • Evaluates, appraises and quantifies data derived from personal or business financial information and establishes insurable interest in keeping with the principle of indemnification.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Education: Undergraduate studies in medical related discipline, marketing, insurance, risk management, economics, finance or business management preferred.

Experience: 2 years underwriting experience; medical background; graduation from the training program.

Very comfortable negotiating offers and calling out on offers that are other than applied for to explain reasons to the advisor or sales leader.

Basic knowledge of products and reinsurance - is comfortable and has relationships with our facultative reinsurance partners. Solid verbal and written communication skills for contact with agents, associates, applicants for insurance, policyholders and outside suppliers of underwriting information. Ability to analyze, assess and classify life insurance risks to achieve company mortality and morbidity objectives. Ability to understand, anticipate and proactively act on customer needs. Ability to set work priorities that conform to time, service and quality standards.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.
