Overview

The Senior Contracts Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading activities related to complex healthcare technology contracting across the enterprise. The position resides within the Corporate Governance and Risk organization, and works closely with all areas of the company, including Enterprise Risk Management, Audit, Security, Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Sales and Marketing, Customer Account Executives, and Vendor Management Operations.

The Senior Contracts Manager seeks to improve contract governance through templates, playbooks, Contract Life Cycle Management (CLM) workflows, automation, and responsible use of AI-enabled tools. This role balances business enablement with risk mitigation by advising senior stakeholders, developing negotiation strategy, and ensuring agreements align with all legal and regulatory requirements while supporting business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Leads end-to-end contract lifecycle management for complex agreements, including drafting, reviewing and negotiating contracts, as assigned
  • Evaluates and provides substantive support related to legal and business contractual terms
  • Advises senior leaders on contractual risk, business impact, and recommended positions to support timely and informed decision-making
  • Partners with Enterprise Risk Management, Audit, Security, Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Sales and Marketing, Customer Account Executives, and Vendor Management to align agreements with NASCO delivery models, regulatory requirements, service commitments, and enterprise risk standards
  • Works with Legal department management and colleagues to develop and maintain standardized templates, to improve consistency, quality, and cycle time
  • Optimizes, and supports contract lifecycle management systems, workflows, dashboards, and reporting to improve visibility, governance, and operational efficiency
  • Uses AI-enabled and automation tools responsibly to support contract review and workflow efficiency, all in accordance with NASCO’s AI policies and Legal department management direction
  • Tracks and reports contract performance metrics including cycle time, contract volume, non-standard terms, risk escalations, renewal activity, and stakeholder service levels, as directed by management
  • Ensures agreements appropriately address regulatory, security and audit-readiness requirements
  • Drives continuous improvement across contract governance, intake, review, approval, renewal, and post-execution contract management processes
  • Provides guidance on contract management best practices

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Advanced knowledge of commercial vendor, partner and customer contract structures, in regard to data privacy, security, service levels, implementation services, SaaS and other business models, and renewal terms
  • Strong understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance considerations
  • Advanced contract drafting, negotiation, and issue-resolution skills, with the ability to independently manage complex agreements
  • Strong commercial and business acumen
  • Ability to identify, assess, communicate, and mitigate contractual risk while balancing business enablement
  • Ability to advise senior leaders, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and communicate complex contractual issues and provide guidance in clear, practical terms
  • Ability to develop, update, and manage contract templates and governance standards
  • Knowledge of contract lifecycle management systems, workflow automation, AI-enabled tools, dashboards, reporting, and contract performance metrics
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage a high-volume, high-complexity contract portfolio
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, and ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of healthcare technology contracting environments
  • Skill in negotiating business associate agreements, data use agreements, and SaaS subscription terms
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled contract review, contract analytics, clause extraction, obligation tracking, or workflow automation tools
  • Ability to partner with teams across an enterprise to improve deal velocity while maintaining appropriate risk controls

Experience:

  • 8 years of progressive contracts management experience, including complex technology (including SaaS and other models) agreements
  • Demonstrated experience leading and/or participating in contract negotiations, advising senior stakeholders, managing risk escalations, and improving contract processes or governance

Preferred Experience:

  • 10 years of contracts management experience in regulated healthcare technology or similarly complex environment
  • Experience supporting digital transformation, product-led operating models, and modernization of contract operations
  • Experience with CLM, CRM, e-signature, and document management tools such as DocuSign, HubSpot, Gatekeeper, SharePoint, or similar platforms

Required Training, Certification and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, legal studies, or related field

Preferred Training, Certification and Education:

  • Master’s degree in business or Juris Doctor
  • Professional certifications such as CPCM or CCCM through the National Contract Management Association

Working Conditions:

  • Remote home office
  • Must be able to use equipment at workstation for up to 8 hours daily

Benefits Overview

At NASCO, we trust our workforce to be fully remote, working from their home. This benefit offers significant, personalized outcomes for each associate including work/life balance, savings on commuting, work clothing, and increased time to spend on personal activities.

Our full benefit package is designed to support the physical, mental, and financial health of our associates. We offer:

Physical and Mental Health Benefits

  • Choice of Blue Cross Blue Shield Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans
  • Telehealthcare – for Medical and Behavioral visits
  • Generous PTO with buy/sell options
  • 9 Company holidays, a floating day off, and a day off for volunteering
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness program - earn insurance discounts or credit towards health-related items

Financial Health Benefits

  • 401K Plan with employer matching contributions
  • Company-funded spending/reimbursement accounts to help with out-of-pocket medical expenses
  • Bonus and Recognition programs
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Consultation with financial planner
  • Basic Life & AD&D Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance provided, and Supplemental Term Life Insurance is available
  • Group Discount programs - mobile, technology services, etc., to help you save money

Other Benefits

  • E-Learning – Comprehensive and current library of e-learning and performance support assets, available on demand and at no cost

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other grounds, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, protected veteran status or status as an individual with a disability. Must have legal authority to work in the US.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT PERLE Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Hungarian transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Standard Hungarian (magyar) and its spoken regional varieties. Project audio reflects everyday Hungarian speech with awareness of its agglutinative morphology and complex case system.

Primary speaker regions: Budapest, Debrecen, Szeged, Miskolc, Pecs, Gyor.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Hungarian with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Hungary or a Hungarian-speaking region
  • Mastery of standard Hungarian orthography
  • Strong ear for regional Hungarian accents
  • Comfort with the demands of transcribing Hungarian morphology accurately
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Finno-Ugric linguistics, translation, journalism, or media
  • Prior experience annotating Hungarian speech data
  • Working knowledge of Finnish, Estonian, or regional Slavic languages
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

  • Design systems that process hundreds of thousands of records across heterogeneous sources (PDF, HTML, APIs, XLS) with high reliability

Agency Relationship Management:

Business Development & Outreach:

Strategic Growth & Market Research:

Ongoing Client Engagement & Support:

  • Assist senior team members in daily activities, supporting overall business objectives.

Additional Qualifications:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: SR.  PRODUCT MANAGER - SEEKINGProduct | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to Head of Product Company Seeking.
jobs.description:
SR. PRODUCT MANAGER - SEEKING

Product | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to Head of Product

Company Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location Remote, anywhere in the USA

Compensation $135,000 to $225,000 base

Travel Required for team weeks, user research, and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We work at the intersection of technology, consumer psychology, and product design at the highest level. Our mission is to help people foster genuine relationships and find love, and to rethink how social platforms can advance human connection.

We are hiring the Product Manager who is going to help us design and ship the next generation of Seeking: a dating platform good enough to end the current era of dating apps. This is a role for the person who is excellent at the craft and passionate about the purpose of the craft, which is designing and building products that actually serve real customers. You will own the Seeking core experience end-to-end across web and native mobile: onboarding, discovery, matching, messaging, profile, and the subscription surface.

This role is open at two levels: Product Manager and Sr. Product Manager. Level and placement in the salary band are determined by depth of shipping history, ownership scope, and demonstrated customer impact. The role is the same shape at both levels; the Sr. level carries broader scope, more autonomy, and higher expectations on prioritization judgment and mentorship.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is Product Manager, Sr. Product Manager, Principal PM, Tech Lead PM, Founding PM, Product Engineer, Design Engineer, Group PM, or Growth PM. If your day-to-day is designing, shipping, and reading products that move real customer outcomes, you should apply regardless of your current title.

Most people with "Product Manager" on their business card are not building products. They are managing a queue, running a status meeting, and writing tickets from a backlog someone else prioritized. That is not the role we are hiring for. If you are a Product Manager by title but not by craft, do not apply. If you are one of the small number of Product Managers who love designing products for real people, and you can point to work that has moved the needle for those people, keep reading.

What You'll Own

Core Experience Ownership

  • Own the roadmap for the Seeking core experience across web and native mobile.
  • Set North Star and input metrics, and hold the line on them.
  • Make ruthless prioritization calls and defend them to the Head of Product, the CEO, and engineering leadership.

Doing the Work, Not Just Briefing It

  • Sketch, wireframe, and high-fidelity prototype features in Figma, Framer, or code before they touch the engineering backlog.
  • Write specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria clean enough that engineers using Claude Code can build directly from them.
  • Use agent-assisted environments to produce real, testable artifacts inside a single sitting.

Experimentation, Data, and Voice of the Customer

  • Design, run, and interpret A/B tests on activation, engagement, retention, and monetization.
  • Instrument every feature with the data layer in mind from day one, using Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase, or comparable.
  • Talk to members. Sit in on user interviews. Read the support tickets. Bring what you hear back into the roadmap.
  • Advocate for the member in every trade-off conversation, and be able to defend the trade-off you did make.

Agentic Operating Model

  • Build and refine agent workflows that let you produce at scale on your own.
  • Contribute to a growing internal playbook so the whole product team compounds.

Required Qualifications (Both Levels)

  • Referenceable shipping history. Specific features or products you owned end-to-end, with specific outcomes. If you cannot name the metric you moved and by how much, this is not the role for you.
  • Demonstrated ability to do the work, not just direct it. Recent product work where you personally drove the research, prototype, spec, and launch.
  • Strong UX and design sensibility. You can prototype, critique, and defend product design choices at the level of a product designer.
  • Daily, fluent use of agentic AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based workflows, or comparable). You will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview.
  • Technical fluency. You read code, write SQL, understand APIs and data schemas, and have working knowledge of how modern consumer software is built and deployed.
  • Hands-on fluency with product and mobile analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase, or comparable). Native mobile experience on iOS and/or Android is strongly preferred.
  • Outstanding written communication. Specs, briefs, decision docs. Your writing should be a competitive advantage.
  • Systems thinking, business instincts (conversion, LTV, retention, monetization), and the ability to hold a strategy conversation with the founder without waiting to be handed the question.

Level & Experience

Product Manager

  • Two to four years in product, product engineering, design engineering, or a comparable operator role, ideally with time in consumer B2C, mobile, or subscription businesses.
  • At least one feature or product you personally led from concept through launch, with a measurable customer outcome you can quote.
  • Rising-star trajectory. You have been promoted quickly, taken on scope beyond your title, or shipped work that outpaces peers with more experience.
  • Comfortable owning a defined surface with mentorship from the Sr. PM and Head of Product.

Sr. Product Manager

  • Five or more years in product, with meaningful time at the Senior PM, Principal PM, Group PM, Tech Lead PM, or Founding PM level. Title-flexible, output-strict.
  • Multiple shipped products or features you owned end-to-end, with measurable outcomes you can quote.
  • Owns both execution and strategy. Sets standards, drives prioritization, and can defend a call to the Head of Product and CEO.
  • Comfortable being a mentor and reviewer as the product function scales.

Preferred Qualifications (Both Levels)

  • Prior experience in dating, social, marketplace, subscription, or other consumer-focused product categories.
  • Hands-on background in design, engineering, or data science, in addition to product.
  • Experience setting up local agent environments (custom orchestration, self-hosted MCP servers).
  • Public work we can look at: a portfolio, prototypes, case studies, technical writing, or an agent toolkit you have shared.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, design, human-computer interaction, or a related field. An MBA or technical Master's is welcome but not required.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $135,000 to $225,000, commensurate with experience and level. The lower half of the band anchors the Product Manager level; the upper half anchors the Sr. Product Manager level.
  • Full-time, salaried, fully remote within the US.
  • 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision insurance. 65% coverage for qualified dependents. 100% coverage of short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance for qualified employees. 50% 401(k) match up to 6% per month. Flexible Spending Account. Flexible paid time off.
  • Direct exposure to the CEO from day one, and a clear growth path as product scope expands.

Bonus: include links. A portfolio, a case study, a prototype, a short Loom, an agent setup you have shared publicly. Anything that lets us see how you operate.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Reflex Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We strictly prohibit discrimination of any kind. Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check.

jobs.description:
Senior Director, Analyst – Cybersecurity Leadership

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

Frontend Development (Angular)

  • Design and build responsive, maintainable Angular applications and components, including state management, routing, and reusable component libraries.
  • Consume and integrate REST APIs into the UI, handling loading states, error handling, and data validation.
  • Build UI components that surface agentic AI features (chat interfaces, recommendation panels, agent status/monitoring dashboards, etc.) within existing or new applications.
  • Collaborate with design/UX to translate requirements into polished, accessible interfaces.

API & Backend Development (.NET)

  • Design and develop backend services and APIs in .NET (C#), following REST/gRPC best practices for consumption by the Angular front-end and downstream systems.
  • Architect and implement integration layers connecting Python-based agentic services with .NET applications (via APIs, message queues, or SDKs).

  • Ensure secure, scalable, and maintainable integration patterns across all application layers.

Database Engineering (SQL Server)

  • Design, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases supporting transactional application data and agentic workflow data (logging, agent state, audit trails, metadata).
  • Write and tune complex stored procedures, queries, indexes, and ETL processes for both application and agentic workflow needs.
  • Own data model design decisions in partnership with backend and API development.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Build and maintain automated test suites using Playwright for UI and end-to-end testing across the full application stack.
  • Write unit and integration tests for .NET services and APIs as part of the standard development workflow, not as a separate hand-off.
  • Develop testing strategies specific to agentic systems (prompt regression testing, output validation, agent behavior testing, edge-case/adversarial testing).
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD pipeline maintenance, and release quality gates.

Agentic AI Integration

  • Integrate with third-party or internally hosted AI/LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI) to power agentic capabilities within applications.
  • Write Python-based scripts/services for agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar, and wire them into the .NET/Angular application stack.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deploy, monitor, and manage application services and supporting infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP (e.g., Lambda/Cloud Functions, container services, storage, IAM).
  • Collaborate with DevOps to ensure scalable, cost-efficient, and secure cloud deployments across the full stack.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in .NET / C# development (API and backend services).
  • 7+ years of experience with SQL Server (database design, optimization, stored procedures, performance tuning).
  • 3+ years of hands-on Angular UI development experience, including component architecture, state management, and consuming REST APIs.
  • Demonstrated true full stack ownership: comfortable working across Angular, API design, .NET backend, SQL Server, and test automation without needing to hand off between specialists.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building or integrating agentic AI workflows/systems that orchestrate existing AI/LLM APIs (not model training or fine-tuning).
  • Experience with Playwright (or similar) for automated UI/end-to-end testing, and writing unit/integration tests for backend services.
  • Practical experience with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration).
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting and AI service integration.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP cloud platforms for deploying and managing application workloads.
  • Strong understanding of REST API design and service-to-service integration patterns.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work across the full stack, from UI to database, without silos.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Experience consuming LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI) within application workflows.
  • Experience with vector databases and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures as a consumer of these services.
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Experience with prompt engineering and agent evaluation/observability tools.
  • Background in enterprise application modernization projects that incorporate agentic AI capabilities.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Position Overview

RMI is searching for a Corporate Engagement Officer to support the development and management of a portfolio of current and prospective corporate partners and other complex institutional accounts. The Corporate Engagement Officer will act as a point of contact for partners in their portfolio, liaising with them and informing them of RMI’s organizational and programmatic impact.

This role will spend significant time stewarding relationships with existing corporate partners while identifying and cultivating new corporate prospects for RMI. Additional responsibilities include supporting the growth of corporate contributions, sponsorships, grants, and other program-aligned partnership opportunities.

The Corporate Engagement Officer will be a key contributor to the Development and Corporate Engagement teams and will be essential to the achievement of the organization’s fundraising, partnership, and impact goals. As needed, this position may also provide support across RMI’s donor and partner portfolios.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Management

  • Manage and grow revenue from a portfolio of current and prospective corporate partners and complex institutional accounts with annual revenue of $500k+ to RMI.

  • Within a portfolio, support all aspects of partner relationships, including coordinating conversations, preparing outreach, submitting proposals and reports, and responding to inquiries.

  • Create touch points with corporate partners through meetings with RMI staff, proactive outreach and scheduling, preparation of meeting briefings with strategic goals and background, development of meeting content, and follow-up after meetings.

  • Provide regular updates to Development and Corporate Engagement leadership on partner conversations, pipelines, opportunities, and relationship status.

  • Ensure corporate partners are appropriately acknowledged and featured in RMI reports, stewardship materials, events, and other key communications, where relevant.

Strategic Engagement

  • With programmatic staff, support the creation of corporate engagement strategies and cases for support.

  • Through research and active conversations, understand corporate partners’ sustainability priorities, climate commitments, business context, philanthropic interests, and partnership goals to effectively represent RMI’s work.

  • Identify, qualify, solicit, and steward new corporate prospects capable of making five-, six-, and seven-figure contributions, sponsorships, grants, or other strategic commitments.

  • Provide a high-quality experience for corporate partners and potential partners through education and engagement on RMI’s program portfolio.

  • Travel to meet with corporate partners and prospects where they are, including at U.S. and global conferences, convenings, and partner meetings.

Proposal Development and Reporting

  • Support and lead, as appropriate, the development of compelling corporate proposals, partnership concepts, letters of inquiry, pitch materials, stewardship reports, and associated budgets to meet partner deadlines and expectations.

  • Collaborate with program, accounting, finance, legal, and communications teams to ensure timely submissions of proposals, grant applications, partnership materials, and reports.

  • Oversee or support the creation and timely submission of regular stewardship reports to corporate partners, including narrative, impact, and financial reports as needed.

  • Respond to partner requests as they emerge to resolve edits to proposals, budgets, partnership concepts, scopes of work, and reporting materials.

  • Review proposal budgets and partnership deliverables to ensure alignment with program budgets, partner expectations, and RMI’s internal requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with program teams to gain a comprehensive understanding of RMI’s work and its alignment with corporate partners’ priorities.

  • Prepare briefings, strategic plans, talking points, and communications materials for partner meetings, drawing from the expertise of program teams and senior leadership.

  • Serve as a lead Development or Corporate Engagement point of contact for one to two RMI programs, supporting corporate engagement pipelines, partner strategy, and fundraising materials.

  • Provide guidance and feedback on corporate-facing materials and ensure program representatives have the information needed to engage with corporate partners.

  • Inform the Development and Corporate Engagement teams of major program updates, partner intelligence, market trends, and strategic opportunities on a regular basis.

Database Management and Reporting

  • Utilize Salesforce to document moves management, corporate engagement pipelines, relationship history, opportunity stages, revenue projections, and accurate relationship status.

  • Utilize Monday.com or other project management systems to highlight upcoming reporting, proposal, stewardship, or partner engagement deadlines.

  • Maintain accurate and timely records of partner interactions, next steps, deliverables, commitments, and risks.

Team Contribution

  • As needed, work across the Development and Corporate Engagement teams to cover accounts for colleagues on leave and/or provide surge support in priority areas.

  • Actively participate in Development Team and Corporate Engagement meetings, initiatives, and culture.

  • Support the implementation of short- and long-term development and corporate engagement objectives.

  • Contribute to overall Development Team strategy, Corporate Engagement strategy, and RMI’s organizational mission.

  • Perform other duties as required or assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 5-10+ years of experience in nonprofit development, corporate engagement, partnerships, business development, institutional fundraising, sustainability, climate, energy, or relationship management.

  • 5+ years of experience managing corporate, foundation, institutional, or other complex external relationships.

  • Track record of successfully cultivating, soliciting, closing, and stewarding significant corporate, philanthropic, sponsorship, grant, or partnership commitments.

  • Track record of successfully securing at least five-figure contributions, grants, sponsorships, or partnership commitments; experience with six-figure and larger commitments strongly preferred.

  • Experience managing proposal, grant, or partnership development processes involving multiple stakeholders from across an organization.

  • Experience writing successful grant applications, proposals, pitch materials, concept notes, or partnership narratives.

  • Experience working successfully with top-level executives in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working in the environment, climate, sustainability, science, or energy field strongly desired.

  • Experience with corporate sustainability, climate commitments, philanthropy, or strategic partnerships strongly preferred.

  • International experience desired but not required.

GeneralQualifications

  • Knowledge of and passion for RMI’s mission of transforming the global energy system to secure a clean, prosperous, zero-carbon future for all.

  • Knowledge of the principles and practices of nonprofit organizations.

  • Strong understanding of corporate engagement, strategic partnerships, corporate philanthropy, sustainability commitments, and complex relationship management.

  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Ability to translate technical programmatic work into compelling corporate-facing narratives.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with RMI staff, Board members, corporate partners, funding partners, community groups, and other associated agencies.

  • Able to navigate and understand a complicated corporate and philanthropic funding environment with the flexibility to change course quickly with a positive attitude.

  • Ability to manage multiple complex and nuanced projects, relationships, deadlines, and deliverables at the same time.

  • Strong judgment and discretion in managing external relationships, partner expectations, and reputational considerations.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note: At this time, RMI is not able to sponsor employment visas or hire candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the United States. All candidates must have current, independent authorization to work in the U.S. without present or future sponsorship from RMI. We will update our hiring pages if this status changes.

Location

We are a remote-ready company with team members around the globe. Our beautiful and welcoming offices are available for meetings or focused work, whether you are traveling through or living nearby. Our U.S. offices are in New York City; Washington DC; Oakland, California; Boulder, Colorado, and Basalt, Colorado. This role can be located from anywhere in the continental United States.

We provide you with the essential IT equipment plus a one-time home technology payment and a monthly work from home/commuter allowance to ensure you have a comfortable home office set up and necessary supplies.

We love seeing each other in person! We occasionally gather for shared time together like retreats and learning experiences. Be ready to travel for occasional in-person meetings (and of course, we cover travel costs).

Compensation   

At RMI, we prioritize fairness in our pay practices. Salaries are determined based on a mix of experience, market benchmarks, and internal equity across similar roles. The salary range of this position is $96,645-$119,115. New hires typically start toward the lower end of the range, depending on experience and alignment with the role’s scope. In addition to base salary, this position includes an annual bonus target of 10% and eligibility for merit-based increases, which are tied to both individual and organizational performance.

  

Benefits:    

We offer an array of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance

  • 403b retirement match with immediate vesting

  • Group life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability

  • Optional voluntary life, AD&D and accident plans

  • Health savings or flexible spending accounts

  • Fertility and hormonal health support

  • Mental health and wellness support

  • Comprehensive leaves of absence (including generous parental leave)

  • Generous paid time off and sick leave

  • Paid sabbatical leave

  • Regional holidays with at least one extended break in each geography

  • Work from home and home technology allowances

  • Learning & development opportunities (LinkedIn Learning and an annual individual professional development budget)

  • Potential for bonuses and merit increases

  • Discount marketplace (gym memberships, pet insurance, etc.)

  • Hybrid / remote work options

  • Team retreats and geographic meetups

  • Rewards and recognition programs

  

Diversity         

We know that the diversity of our teams makes us stronger as an organization, and RMI is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity as outlined in U.S. federal law. We prohibit discrimination against applicants, interns, and employees on the basis of any legally recognized basis, including but not limited to: age (40 and over), race, color, sex, pregnancy (including lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), religion, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), sexual orientation, gender expression/identity, uniformed service member status, veteran status, citizenship status, or any other applicable status protected by applicable law.

RMI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.excerpt: About Andesa Andesa is the leading provider of policy and plan administration solutions in the Advanced Markets space, including policy transaction management and NQDC recordkeeping.
jobs.description:
About Andesa

Andesa is the leading provider of policy and plan administration solutions in the Advanced Markets space, including policy transaction management and NQDC recordkeeping. These solutions simplify the ongoing administration of complex life insurance and annuity products in BOLI, COLI, ICOLI, and Private Placement. Using market and product expertise, configurable capabilities for complex products, and security and reliability at scale, Andesa improves speed to market and empowers carriers and brokers to serve high-value markets with confidence.

In late March 2026, Terminus Capital Partners, an Atlanta based private equity firm focused on enterprise software companies, acquired a majority stake investment in Andesa to accelerate growth and increase investment in technology modernization, platform capabilities, and long-term innovation, while preserving the company's client-centric culture and operational continuity.

The hiring of a Head of Professional Services builds on this momentum and reflects Andesa's commitment to invest in the people, processes, and platforms behind its policy lifecycle and plan administration solutions.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to lead a critical client delivery function at a company serving a highly specialized and relationship-driven market. As Andesa’s Head of Professional Services, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of client engagements across Andesa platforms, from initial discovery and requirements definition through implementation coordination.

You will own the Professional Services function, including the project management and Business Analyst teams responsible for Client Change Requests (CCRs), client discovery, Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), estimation, scoping, and delivery execution. This role is central to ensuring client-driven requirements are accurately captured, thoughtfully documented, properly scoped, and coordinated into the broader product release process.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role, ideal for someone who can balance people leadership, delivery strategy, client partnership, operational rigor, and continuous process improvement. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering/Development, Sales/Account Management, and Support to ensure client needs are clearly understood, implementation-ready, and aligned with business goals.

What You'll Own

People Management

  • Manage, coach, and lead the Project Management and Business Analyst teams responsible for Client Change Requests (CCRs).
  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, performance management, and career development opportunities for team members.
  • Set individual and team goals while fostering a collaborative, high-performing delivery culture.

Professional Services Leadership and Strategy

  • Lead the day-to-day operations of the Professional Services function across client engagements.
  • Establish and maintain delivery standards, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Define team goals, KPIs, and performance standards aligned with delivery quality and client satisfaction.

Client Delivery Execution

  • Ensure high-quality delivery, timeliness, and client satisfaction across the Professional Services portfolio.
  • Serve as an escalation point for delivery risks, client issues, and cross-project dependencies.
  • Oversee the delivery of new client implementations (new client logos) and related client engagements, ensuring requirements are properly scoped and engagements are successfully delivered.
  • Oversee the intake, triage, prioritization, scoping, and tracking of Client Change Requests (CCRs).
  • Own the estimation process for client engagements and CCRs, ensuring effort, cost, and timeline estimates are accurate and defensible.

Client Discovery and Requirements Management

  • Own the client discovery process for new engagements and change requests.
  • Ensure discovery sessions produce accurate, complete, and actionable business requirements.
  • Establish repeatable discovery frameworks, templates, and documentation standards.
  • Ensure Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) are authored to a consistent, high-quality standard.
  • Review and approve BRDs prior to implementation handoff.
  • Maintain traceability between client discovery findings, documented requirements, and delivered outcomes.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner closely with the Product Owner to communicate delivery timelines, estimates, and client priorities.
  • Coordinate with Engineering and Development teams on implementation feasibility and delivery timelines.
  • Align with Sales, Account Management, and Support teams to ensure client expectations and delivery commitments are met.

Continuous Improvement

  • Lead initiatives to optimize Professional Services tools, processes, and documentation standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve discovery, estimation, delivery practices, and overall operational effectiveness.

What We’re Looking For

This role requires a strong blend of client delivery leadership, people management, requirements expertise, and operational discipline. The right candidate is comfortable leading teams, partnering with senior stakeholders, navigating complex client needs, and bringing structure to discovery, estimation, and implementation processes.

Must have

  • 8 to 10 years of experience in professional services, client delivery, or project management leadership roles.
  • Strong knowledge of the life and annuity insurance industry, preferably including executive benefits.
  • Demonstrated experience managing Business Analysts and/or project teams.
  • Proven ability to lead client delivery and Business Analyst teams in an Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid environment.
  • Expertise in requirements gathering, discovery facilitation, and BRD authorship.
  • Strong background in estimation, scoping, and coordination with product/release management processes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including with senior client contacts.
  • Comfortable engaging with technical teams on system architecture and implementation feasibility.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with Jira, SharePoint, GitHub, and AI-enabled productivity or delivery tools.
  • Experience improving or scaling delivery methodologies, discovery frameworks, templates, and documentation standards.
  • Experience working closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Sales, Account Management, and Support in a client delivery environment.
  • Ability to travel, including occasional overnight stays.

What We Offer

  • Starting base salary range of $125,000-$175,000 with performance driven variable compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees
  • 401(k) retirement plan with competitive employer matching contributions
  • Generous PTO program with annual allocations based on years of service
  • The opportunity to lead and shape a critical Professional Services function as Andesa continues to invest in client delivery, technology modernization, and long-term growth

How to Apply

Send your resume and a cover letter about why this role interests you by clicking the "Apply now" application link. If you have examples of professional services leadership, client delivery transformation, requirements management, or process improvement initiatives you’ve led, we’d welcome the opportunity to review them.

Andesa Services is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.

Work Environment

Work Schedule: This is a full-time (40 Hours/Week) exempt position. Hours are flexible within core business hours. This position is fully remote reporting out of our office in Allentown, PA.

Location: Remote

Reports to: Chief Services Officer

Type: Full-time

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Are you an experienced actuary who enjoys complex annuity valuation, financial reporting, and solving thorny modeling problems? Join our Retirement Solutions Financial Reporting team and help shape how we measure and manage results across a diverse block of retirement products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support quarterly GAAP and statutory valuation, financial reporting, and forecasting for Retirement Solutions products (e.g., fixed and indexed annuities, stable value, protected retirement/in plan guarantee products).

  • Maintain and enhance GGY AXIS models and related tools ensuring methods remain robust, efficient, and well-controlled.

  • Partner with Pricing, Controllership, and Valuation to support transactions (e.g., reinsurance, block transfers) and strategic projects that improve capital efficiency and reduce earnings volatility.

  • Collaborate with peers and leaders to identify and implement process and model improvements that enhance transparency, consistency, and speed-to-decision.

What We’re Looking For

Must-have skills

  • Strong background in retirement product or annuity valuation (GAAP and/or statutory), with experience supporting quarterly closes and/or forecasting.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major actuarial modeling platform (e.g., GGY AXIS, MG-ALFA) and comfort working with complex projection models.

  • Solid data and tooling skills (e.g., SQL, Excel/VBA) with the ability to trace results from model output through to the ledger and financial statements.

  • Proven ability to communicate complex actuarial concepts to non-actuarial partners (finance, controllership, business leadership).

  • Demonstrated ownership mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities around key reporting deadlines.

  • ASA Required; FSA or progress towards FSA highly preferred.

Preferred skills

jobs.description:
Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist / Sr. CRO Specialist

Growth & Lifecycle Marketing | Full-Time, Exempt | Reports to Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

Run the testing program that turns hunches into decisions, and decisions into compounding growth.

Company Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location Remote (US).

Compensation $80,000 to $125,000 base, commensurate with experience and level

Travel Required for team meetings, offsites, and project needs

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, and we are entering the most important chapter of our brand transformation. We are looking for a CRO Specialist to run the day-to-day testing program across paid media, email/lifecycle, landing pages, onboarding, and creative, and turn results into clear, actionable recommendations for channel owners.

This role is open at two levels: CRO Specialist and Sr. CRO Specialist. Level and placement in the salary band are determined by experience, depth in testing platforms and analytics, and demonstrated ownership of end-to-end experiments. The role is the same shape at both levels; the Senior level carries broader scope, more autonomy, and higher expectations on statistical rigor, cross-channel synthesis, and mentorship.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist, Growth Marketing Specialist, Growth Marketing Manager, Experimentation Specialist, Experimentation Analyst, A/B Testing Specialist, Growth Analyst, Optimization Analyst, Digital Experience Optimization Specialist, or Landing Page Optimization Specialist. If your day-to-day is designing, shipping, and reading tests that move business metrics, you should apply regardless of your current title.

You will build the testing roadmap, ship the variants, read the results, and rewrite the plan by Friday. You will report to the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing and partner closely with Paid Media, Lifecycle/CRM, SEO, Creative, Data & Analytics, Product, and Brand.

We are looking for a hands-on operator who can log into the testing platform in week one, audit what is running, identify what is misdesigned or missing a control, and ship a better-instrumented test by Friday.

What You'll Own

Testing Roadmap, Prioritization & Program Management

  • Own and maintain a rolling testing roadmap and hypothesis backlog across paid media, email/lifecycle, landing pages, onboarding, paywall, and creative.
  • Prioritize tests with a clear framework (ICE, PIE, or a Seeking variant) so the highest-impact, highest-confidence experiments run first.
  • Keep an always-current view of what is being tested, what has been learned, and what is next, and communicate it weekly to the Director and channel owners.
  • Set and hold testing velocity: the right number of concurrent, non-interfering experiments running at all times.

Test Design & Execution

  • Design and launch A/B, multivariate, and (where appropriate) holdout and geo-based experiments with proper control groups, adequate sample sizes, and pre-defined success metrics.
  • Set up and QA tests in the experimentation platform (Optimizely, VWO, Statsig, Convert, AB Tasty, or comparable). You build the tests yourself.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics and Engineering on tracking, event instrumentation, and attribution before every launch. You know the events you need, not just the ones you have.
  • Define primary, secondary, and guardrail metrics for every test in plain, business-relevant terms.

Analysis, Insights & Recommendations

  • Analyze test results using GA4, the testing platform, and warehouse cuts. Know the difference between statistical significance and business significance, and hold the line on both.
  • For every completed test, deliver a structured recommendation by a committed date: ship it, iterate on it, or kill it, with the rationale and the next test queued behind it.
  • Translate winning results into channel-specific action: campaign changes for Paid Media; flow logic for Lifecycle/CRM; landing page and onboarding updates with Product; creative direction for the Creative team.
  • Present findings to cross-functional stakeholders in a clear, non-technical narrative that connects the test to the business.

Cross-Channel Synthesis & Testing Culture

  • Connect the dots across channels. Surface patterns from paid tests that should inform lifecycle messaging (and vice versa), and build shared creative and messaging frameworks derived from what the tests have taught us.
  • Partner with Paid Media, Lifecycle/CRM, SEO, and Content to align on learnings, coordinate overlapping tests, and avoid duplicate or conflicting work.
  • Maintain a simple, searchable results repository so we compound learnings instead of relearning them every quarter.
  • Champion a test-and-learn culture through weekly readouts, workshops, and clear testing standards.

Required Qualifications (Both Levels)

  • Hands-on experience running A/B or multivariate tests in a marketing or growth context (paid, email, landing page, onboarding, or paywall), preferably at a consumer subscription, marketplace, mobile-first, or dating/social platform.
  • In-the-tool fluency with at least one experimentation or A/B testing platform (Optimizely, VWO, Statsig, Convert, AB Tasty, Eppo, LaunchDarkly, or comparable). You set up and QA the tests yourself.
  • Working understanding of experimental design: control/treatment setup, sample sizing, statistical significance, and common validity threats (novelty, seasonality, SRM, interaction effects). You know when to call a test and when to wait.
  • Strong analytical fluency. Comfortable in GA4, testing-platform dashboards, and Excel/Sheets. Able to pull your own reads and pressure-test what the Data team hands you.
  • Ready to run on day one. You can audit an existing testing program, identify what is misdesigned, and ship a better-instrumented experiment in week one.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a crisp test brief and present nuanced results to a non-technical audience with equal confidence.
  • AI fluency. You already use ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Cowork, or similar in your daily workflow to draft test plans, generate variant copy and creative, analyze results, and replace work you used to do by hand. If someone has to explain to you why AI matters, this role is not for you.
  • Operator's discipline. You ship on time, your QA is tight, your naming is clean, and you document every result.

Level & Experience

CRO Specialist

  • 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in CRO, growth marketing, experimentation, or analytical marketing.
  • Practical track record designing and shipping tests across at least one of: paid media, email/lifecycle, landing pages, or onboarding, with results you can speak to.
  • Owns execution end-to-end across the channels above. Contributes to prioritization and testing-cadence conversations with the Director.

Sr. CRO Specialist

  • 5 to 8+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, experimentation, or growth marketing, ideally including time at a consumer subscription business, DTC brand, or mobile-first product.
  • Proven track record running experiments across two or more channels (paid, lifecycle, landing pages, onboarding, paywall, or in-product marketing), with measurable business impact.
  • Comfortable in SQL or directly in the warehouse to build audiences, validate segments, and pull your own analysis. You do not wait on the Data team to know how a test performed.
  • Owns both execution and strategy. Sets testing standards, drives the roadmap, and can defend a prioritization call to the Director and CMO.
  • Mentors and reviews. Comfortable being the go-to reviewer for test design, tracking hygiene, and results interpretation as the testing function scales.

Preferred Qualifications (Both Levels)

  • Consumer subscription, marketplace, or dating/social platform experience where activation, retention, and LTV are primary growth levers.
  • Familiarity with Bayesian methods, multi-armed bandit, or adaptive experimentation, with a clear view on when to use them.
  • Background in behavioral economics or consumer psychology. Understanding why people behave the way they do makes for sharper hypotheses.
  • Experience contributing to a company-wide experimentation program (governance, tooling, standards, or team training).
  • Experience designing experiments around AI-driven personalization or recommendation systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent track record of shipping rigorous tests.

Compensation

  • Base salary: $80,000 to $125,000, commensurate with experience and level. The lower half of the band anchors the CRO Specialist level; the upper half anchors the Sr. CRO Specialist level.
  • Full-time, exempt, fully remote within the US.
  • Health, dental, vision, 401(k), and a standard benefits package.
  • Direct exposure to the Director, CMO, and Co-CEOs from day one, and a clear growth path as testing scope, channel ownership, and program maturity expand.

Seeking.com is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on capability and fit.

This job description is intended to convey essential responsibilities and is not exhaustive. Duties may evolve as the business grows.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Title:Contract Senior Clinical Research Associate

Department:Monitoring

Location: Utah

PURPOSE

The Contract Senior Clinical Research Associate (CRA) conducts site monitoring responsibilities for clinical trials, according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), FDA regulations, ICH guidelines, and Good Clinical Practices (GCP).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESinclude the following.

Other duties may be assigned. Contractor performs all, part, and/or any combination of the duties listed below.

  • Independently manages and monitors site activities for assigned clinical studies, working individually or co-monitoring with other CRAs.
  • Monitoring activities will include but not be limited to site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out visits. These visits will be completed independently.
  • During monitoring visits, the CRA ensures compliance with the protocol and applicable Lotus or Sponsor SOPs, FDA regulations, and ICH-GCP guidelines.
  • Independently and proficiently performs site evaluation visits of potential investigators. Thoroughly evaluates the site’s capability to successfully manage and conduct the clinical study.
  • Expertly and independently performs study initiation activities, reviewing with the site personnel the protocol, regulatory issues, study procedures, and provides training on completion of the case report forms, monitoring activities and study close-out activities.
  • Ensures the Investigator Site File is kept audit-ready and ensures documents are collected and uploaded into the Trial Master File on a regular and timely basis.
  • Has direct communication with investigational sites on visit planning, query resolution, action item resolution, and any other activities to support site management.
  • Independently documents accountability, stability and storage conditions of clinical trial materials as required by the Monitoring Plan. Performs investigational product inventory. Ensures return of unused materials to designated location or verifies destruction as required.
  • Serves as primary contact with the site; coordinates all correspondence; ensures timely transmission of clinical data with the study site.
  • Expertly and independently performs study close-out visits per the study specific Monitoring Plan including final investigational product reconciliation and disposition, site study file reconciliation, data query resolution through to database lock and resolution of outstanding action items.
  • Ensures internal and study-related trainings are completed per Lotus and/or study timelines.
  • Pre and post visit follow up include compliance to timelines indicated in the Monitoring Plan for Confirmation Letters, Follow up Letters and Monitoring Visit Reports.
  • Performs other related duties as requested.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Position does not require direct supervision over other team members; however, position may require collaboration with the CRA Line Manager to support the mentoring, training, and assessment of CRAs and junior staff as applicable.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Ability and willingness to travel up to 100% of the time (land and air), both domestically. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in life science/healthcare is required accompanied by at least 5 years of field experience working within clinical research as a CRA.

Mastery of the CRA II Job Responsibilities.

Valid Driver’s License.

Legally authorized to work in the US as an independent contractor (LLC or INC.) or through an agency.

SKILLS and/or ABILITIES

Expert knowledge of the drug development process, ICH guidelines, GCP, and the clinical trial process.

Proficiency in using electronic CRF platforms and processes.

Excellent interpersonal skills.

Exceptional attention to detail.

Ability to interact effectively within and across team environments.

Excellent organizational skills.

Exceptional ability to exercise professional judgment and uphold ICH GCP guidelines and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.

Strong ability to work effectively and efficiently handling multiple tasks simultaneously.

Consistent ability to manage and meet multiple deadlines.

Ability to work independently.

Proficient computer skills with good working knowledge of a range of standard computer software required (e.g., email, document, spreadsheet, and presentation software).Ability to submit invoices, expense reports, etc. in a timely manner in accordance with Lotus’s Finance Department requirements.

Contractor shall be responsible for their own insurance.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a contractor to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the Contractor regularly reaches with hands and arms. The contractor periodically is required to lift and/or carry up to 10 pounds. Occasionally, contractor stoops, bends, kneels, and crouches; and pushes/pulls filled wheeled carts. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a contractor encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

May work in a clinical research site environment where the noise level is usually moderate, a travel environment where the noise level is usually moderate to high, or in home office environment where the noise level is largely controlled by the contractor. Contractor may be subject to many interruptions; pressure due to meet deadline requirements; and handling multiple tasks simultaneously while performing assigned duties.

SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

Contractor is required to pay particular attention to safety practices when traveling and/or visiting a clinical research site including following all safety, environmental, and infection control guidelines, procedures and protocols including wearing appropriate safety/protective equipment. In the interest of safety, Lotus Clinical Research contractors should practice safe use of cell phones and other mobile devices while driving on Company business and/or Company time.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Xsolla is seeking a Head of Fund Operations to stand up and run the operating machinery of the Xsolla Credit Fund. You have taken a private fund from formation through first close before, and you know the full stack: structure and LPA work with counsel, service-provider selection, LP onboarding, capital calls, valuation policy, reporting, and audit readiness.

This is a builder's mandate. You will design the fund's operating playbook, run it, and document it so the fund operates to institutional standards from day one — and mentor the junior operations hires who join as the fund scales.

The role reports directly to Stan Rudoi, Chief Credit Officer and Head of the Xsolla Credit Fund.

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

Beyond its core commerce platform, Xsolla is building a private credit fund that lends to video game studios, underwritten with a data advantage no traditional lender has: Xsolla's own payments telemetry across thousands of games. The fund is in its capital formation phase and is led by Stan Rudoi, Chief Credit Officer. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help raise a first-time fund inside a profitable, global gaming-commerce company, alongside the broader Xsolla capital markets ecosystem (Xsolla Funding Club, Xsolla SPAC 1 — Nasdaq: XSLLU, and other strategic vehicles).

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities

    Fund Formation and Structuring

  • Drive fund formation with external fund counsel: vehicle and jurisdiction selection, LPA and side letters, GP and management company setup, and the regulatory perimeter.
  • Own the LPA from the operator's seat: terms, economics, and governance mechanics — and translate them into operational reality once signed.

    • Service Provider Stack

  • Select and manage the provider stack: fund administrator, auditor, tax advisors, banking/custody, and compliance vendors — and manage them to institutional standards.
  • Own provider economics: negotiate scopes and fees; keep the fund's operating cost model lean and LP-defensible.

    • Fund Operations

  • Run the core machinery: capital calls and distributions, LP onboarding and KYC/AML, expense management, and cash movement controls.
  • Own valuation and NAV: valuation policy, NAV oversight with the administrator, and credit-fund specifics such as borrowing-base mechanics and leverage facility administration.

    • LP Reporting and Diligence Readiness

  • Build the reporting stack: quarterly reporting (ILPA-aligned), capital account statements, and LP communications infrastructure.
  • Keep the fund diligence-ready: DDQ responses, operational due-diligence readiness, and the operations sections of the data room — before LPs ask.

    • Compliance and Governance

  • Establish the policy framework: valuation, allocation, conflicts, and ESG/AML policies; regulatory filings with counsel; audit coordination.
  • Design for scrutiny: so every process has a documented owner, control, and audit trail that stands up to institutional operational due diligence.

    • Operating Playbook and Team Building

  • Codify the fund's operating playbook: documented processes, controls, and owners for every core workflow — built for operational due diligence from day one.
  • Scale the function: as the fund scales, build out and mentor the junior operations team (controller, fund accountants) and integrate with Xsolla's finance and legal teams.

Qualifications and Skills

    Experience

  • 7+ years in fund operations, fund CFO, or fund controllership roles at private credit or other private capital funds.
  • You have taken at least one private fund from formation through first close — this is the core requirement. You know what breaks, in what order, and how to prevent it.
  • Deep working knowledge of LPA terms, fund administration, capital call mechanics, and ILPA reporting standards.
  • Credit-fund specifics — leverage facilities, borrowing bases, loan administration, asset-level reporting — are a strong plus.

    • Skills and Competencies

  • Hands-on operator: comfortable being the entire operations function on day one, with providers as your leverage.
  • Rigorous documentation and controls discipline; you build processes that pass operational due diligence, not just processes that work.
  • Strong commercial judgment on provider selection, fee negotiation, and build-vs-outsource decisions.
  • Clear communicator who can explain fund mechanics to non-fund people — including investors, borrowers, and Xsolla leadership.

    • Education and Credentials

  • A bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field; CPA, a CFA charter, or an MBA is preferred.

Benefits

We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. jobs.description:
Role Summary

We're a small, hard-working team building something ambitious: a member platform that delivers personalized access to jobs, events, resources, and mentoring on a global scale. We've built it agentically, moving fast, and we need a Senior Product Manager to own execution and success of that platform, working in close partnership with our VP of Technology, who sets product direction and vision.

This isn't a role in a mature org with layers of process and a bench of fellow PMs. There is one Dev team, and you are the only product person. You'll take the vision and priorities set at the leadership level and turn them into a roadmap, specs, and platform, working hands-on with the Dev team every day. If you want high ownership over how things get built and you're energized by moving fast in a lean team, this is built for you.

What You’ll Own

You will own execution of the member platform with the Dev team as your closest collaborator. The Marketing, Programs, and Partner teams are key stakeholders you'll align and build with.

Roadmap & Planning

  • Translate product direction and business goals set at the leadership level (member engagement, partner revenue/ROI, scalable personalized support) into a prioritized, sequenced roadmap.
  • Recommend build-vs-buy and sequencing tradeoffs, and bring a clear point of view to those conversations with leadership.

Discovery & Requirements

  • Run member research and analyze usage data to identify what's working and what's not across jobs, events, resources, and mentoring access.
  • Write the specs and requirements the dev team builds against.
  • Define what success looks like for each feature before it ships.

Execution & Delivery

  • Work directly and daily with the Dev team: sprint planning, backlog prioritization, unblocking.
  • Make the day-to-day tradeoff calls between scope, timeline, and quality, keeping the VP of Technology looped in on anything that shifts the roadmap materially.
  • Own the personalized member experience end-to-end: how members discover and access jobs, events, resources, and mentoring in a way that feels tailored to them, not generic.
  • Own documentation to ensure cross-organizational communication

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Be the connective tissue across the Dev, Design, Marketing, Programs, and Partner teams: you translate each group's needs into product decisions and represent product decisions back to them and maintain transparency across the org.
  • Own the partner-facing product experience, working closely with the Partner team to build the features, integrations, or visibility partners need to see real ROI.

Metrics & Reporting

  • Define and track the KPIs that matter: member engagement, partner revenue/ROI, and platform scalability (are we serving more members with the same or better personalized quality?).
  • Report on platform health and roadmap progress to leadership.
  • Let data drive prioritization, and be transparent when it changes your plan.

What Success Looks Like

Engagement

  • A platform members actually use and return to, because it delivers genuinely personalized access to jobs, events, resources, and mentoring.

Partner ROI

  • A partner experience strong enough that partners can point to clear, demonstrable ROI from the platform.

Scale without degradation

  • As the member base grows, the personalized experience doesn't get watered down: quality scales with volume, not against it.

Required Qualifications + Key Competencies

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning execution and delivery for a product area.
  • Comfort operating as the only product person day-to-day, while taking direction from a VP-level product leader. You don't need a product team around you, but you know how to partner closely with leadership.
  • Experience working hands-on with a Dev team through the full build cycle, not just handing off requirements.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts: you can translate between engineering, design, marketing, and partnership language without a translator.
  • A bias toward personalization and member experience: you think about the person on the other end of the platform, not just the feature list.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and speed: we're building agentically and iterating fast, and you should want that pace, not tolerate it.

All Applicants must be authorized to work within the US without the need for current or future sponsorship.

US - Remote

Salary: $135k - $150k
